w_00b86ed2.name: Munro Cabin
w_00b86ed2.reason: Every walker sleeps here on night 2. The cabin is on the Cape Pillar track, not the main line: day 2 turns off at the junction 0.6 km before Retakunna, and day 3 walks out to Cape Pillar and back past the cabin to the same junction. The walk in is the GPX's own Cape Pillar side trip from the junction; its length and climb are the build's figures for the side trip's Munro row (issue #202).
